summary: OceanFirst Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a planned sale of $1.4 billion of multifamily loans acquired in its recent acquisition of Flushing Financial Corporation. The sale is part of a balance sheet repositioning to reduce Commercial Real Estate concentration and eliminate most exposure to New York City rent-regulated properties. The purchase price is consistent with initial valuation estimates. The sale is expected to close by end of Q2 2026. Proceeds will be used to buy investment-grade securities with similar yields. Regulatory clock is not specified; watch for Q2 earnings release for impact details.
